title: Ghost (Swedish band) - Wikipedia
notes: Read to character 100,000 of 224,785, for the persona, the records and the costumes only (passages about members' identities and the 2017 lawsuit deliberately not read or used). Formed in Linköping in 2006; first concert 23 October 2010 at Hammer of Doom, Würzburg. 'Anonymity is a major characteristic of Ghost'; a ghoul said the aim was 'to remove their personalities to allow their audiences to focus upon the artwork itself'. The ghouls 'wear black hooded robes and be called Nameless Ghouls'. From 2010 to 2017 the ghouls 'each represented one of the five elements, typically attached to their instrumental role', wore their alchemical symbol on their instruments and stamped it at signings; for Meliora 'each Nameless Ghoul had all five elemental symbols embroidered on the right breast of their costumes'; after 2018 the element symbols were no longer used (citation needed). Genres: hard rock, heavy metal, arena rock, pop rock, doom metal, progressive rock. Recalls 'the early sounds of Black Sabbath, Pentagram, and Judas Priest' (Begrand); theatrics from Kiss, David Bowie and Alice Cooper, though 'a member said they are more influenced by Pink Floyd'. Cirice won the 2016 Grammy for Best Metal Performance; Skeletá the band's first Billboard 200 number one; hiatus after the Skeletour ended in February 2026.

title: Opus Eponymous - Wikipedia
notes: Released 18 October 2010 (Rise Above); recorded over a few weeks in a basement studio in Linköping (Manfire Recordings, White Light Studio), mixed and mastered by Jaime Gómez Arellano. Heavy metal, doom metal, hard rock, psychedelic rock. Gibson SG and an Orange amp for a 'Seventies vibe'; Con Clavi Con Dio and Genesis are 'sped-up waltzes'. The drums are credited to a named session player, not to a ghoul (the name is not stored here). Grammis nomination 2011.

title: Infestissumam - Wikipedia
notes: Released 10 April 2013 (Sonet / Loma Vista); produced by Nick Raskulinecz; recorded 2012 at Blackbird (Nashville), The Bridge (Glendale), Mayfire (Linköping) and Hufvudstaden (Söderköping). Heavy metal, doom metal, progressive rock, psychedelic rock, pop rock. The main personnel give no drum credit to a named member; deluxe-edition guest credits only. Swedish number one; Grammis Best Hard Rock/Metal Album 2014.

title: Meliora (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released 21 August 2015 (Loma Vista); produced by Klas Åhlund, mixed by Andy Wallace; recorded January 2015 at EastWest, Ameraycan, The Village (Los Angeles) and Riksmixningsverket (Stockholm). Heavy metal, hard rock, progressive rock, psychedelic rock, pop rock. The line-up credits a Nameless Ghoul on drums; additional personnel list a separately credited session drummer (not stored). Classic Rock: 'black-souled retro doom-pop'. Cirice: Grammy, Best Metal Performance, 2016. Billboard 200 number 8.

title: Prequelle - Wikipedia
notes: Released 1 June 2018 (Loma Vista); produced and engineered by Tom Dalgety (also credited with percussion and programming); mixed by Andy Wallace; Artery (Stockholm), Psalm (Bath), Westlake (Los Angeles). Hard rock, arena rock, heavy metal, progressive rock, pop rock. The band credited as 'A Group of Nameless Ghouls'; drums credited to a session drummer under additional personnel (not stored). 1970s and 1980s influences including Blue Öyster Cult, Boston, ABBA and hair metal; AllMusic: 'irresistible arena rock excess'. Billboard 200 number 3; Grammy nomination, Best Rock Album.

title: Impera (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Released 11 March 2022 (Loma Vista); produced by Klas Åhlund; mixed by Andy Wallace; Capitol (Hollywood), Atlantis Metronome and Apmamman (Stockholm), from January 2021. Hard rock, arena rock, glam metal, heavy metal, pop rock; compared with ABBA, Boston, Dio, Bon Jovi and Def Leppard. AllMusic: 'the most unabashed exercise in exultant pop/rock sheen Ghost has issued to date'. Drums credited to a session drummer under additional personnel (not stored). Billboard 200 number 2.

title: Skeletá - Wikipedia
notes: Released 25 April 2025 (Loma Vista); produced by 'Gene Walker' (Tobias Forge) with others; mixed by Andy Wallace and Dan Malsch. Hard rock, arena rock, pop rock, glam metal. Band: Papa V Perpetua and 'A Group of Nameless Ghouls'; drums credited to a session player under additional personnel (not stored). Billboard 200 number 1 (86,000 units). Skeletour: 73 dates, 15 April 2025 to February 2026.

title: If You Have Ghost - Wikipedia
notes: EP, 20 November 2013, produced by Dave Grohl, who played drums and percussion on I'm a Marionette (ABBA) and Waiting for the Night (Depeche Mode) as a credited guest.

title: Rite Here Rite Now - Wikipedia
notes: Concert film and soundtrack (Loma Vista, 26 July 2024), mostly recorded at the Kia Forum, Inglewood, 11 and 12 September 2023, the last North American dates of the Re-Imperatour. The touring band credited as 'Ghouls and Ghoulettes'; the drums are the touring drummer's (the credit's name is not stored here). Tracks include Kaisarion, Rats, Spillways, Cirice, Mary on a Cross, Dance Macabre, Square Hammer. Number 21 on the Billboard 200.

title: Ghost 2016 Hellfest HD full concert (Arte Concert broadcast, Clisson, 19 June 2016; YouTube mD0SbAPLlWE)
notes: Watched as contact sheets and stills, 5:00-8:00 and 25:00-30:00. The drumming ghoul close up at 7:52 (blue light) and 28:10 (white-blue light): a silver full-face mask with two short horns over the brow and swept, ridged 'hair' over the crown; a black high-collared, button-fronted coat with the alchemical symbols on the right breast; bare hands; a black Tama kit with chrome hardware. Two ghouls in profile at 26:03 show the mask's long aquiline nose, the chin drawn down to a point and the ridged sweep curling down behind the ear, a black hood under it.

title: Wikimedia Commons: Ghost Rockavaria 2016 (1-14 von 14), Munich, 29 May 2016 (CC BY-SA 3.0)
notes: Daylight photographs, about 15:20-15:40. The drumming ghoul behind a black Tama kit (one bass drum, black front head with the TAMA logo, one rack tom, floor tom, chrome stands, about six cymbals) in the silver horned mask; other ghouls show the mask's metal clearly: a cool, brushed silver, darker in the eye sockets and ridges, and the black coats with the symbols embroidered in silver-grey.
